-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.TraceSimGhost` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def TraceSim.inFlight (tn : TraceSim.TraceNames) (k : Nat) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) : IProp GF :=
  k ↪[tn.bag] m

structure TraceSim.ServerC : Type where
  currentTerm : Int
  state : Etcdraft.Role
  votedFor : Etcdraft.ID
  lead : Etcdraft.ID
  log : List Etcdraft.Entry
  commitIndex : Int
  votesResponded : Etcdraft.SetIds
  votesGranted : Etcdraft.SetIds
  matchIndex : List Int
  pendingConfChangeIndex : Int
  config : Etcdraft.Config
  durable : Etcdraft.Durable

def TraceSim.toC (srv : Etcdraft.SetIds) (v : Etcdraft.Server) : TraceSim.ServerC :=
  { currentTerm := v.currentTerm, state := v.state, votedFor := v.votedFor, lead := v.lead, log := v.log,
    commitIndex := v.commitIndex, votesResponded := v.votesResponded, votesGranted := v.votesGranted,
    matchIndex := List.map v.matchIndex srv, pendingConfChangeIndex := v.pendingConfChangeIndex, config := v.config,
    durable := v.durable }

def TraceSim.simInit (C : List w64) : Etcdraft.State :=
  have srv := TraceSim.confAbs C;
  have v :=
    { currentTerm := 1, state := Etcdraft.follower, votedFor := Etcdraft.nil, lead := Etcdraft.nil,
      log :=
        List.map
          (fun k =>
            { term := 1, type := Etcdraft.EntryType.config,
              value := Etcdraft.Value.conf (TraceSim.confAbs (List.take (k + 1) C)) [] })
          (List.range C.length),
      commitIndex := ↑C.length, votesResponded := [], votesGranted := [], matchIndex := fun x => 0,
      pendingConfChangeIndex := 0, config := { incoming := srv, outgoing := [], learners := [] }, durable := default };
  { server := srv,
    s := fun x =>
      { currentTerm := v.currentTerm, state := v.state, votedFor := v.votedFor, lead := v.lead, log := v.log,
        commitIndex := v.commitIndex, votesResponded := v.votesResponded, votesGranted := v.votesGranted,
        matchIndex := v.matchIndex, pendingConfChangeIndex := v.pendingConfChangeIndex, config := v.config,
        durable := Etcdraft.durableOf v },
    messages := [], pendingMessages := [], reconfigCount := 0 }

theorem TraceSim.simRun_accepts (C : List w64) (L : List TraceEv) (σ : Etcdraft.State) (t :
    Etcdraft.Trace) : TraceSim.SimRun C L σ → Etcdraft.newTraceWith (List.map TraceSim.evConv L)
    false false = Except.ok t → t.init = TraceSim.simInit C → t.server = TraceSim.confAbs C →
    t.initSrv = TraceSim.confAbs C → Etcdraft.TraceAccepts (List.map TraceSim.evConv L) false false

def TraceSim.simBoot (tn : TraceSim.TraceNames) (i : w64) (b : Bool) (o : Option TraceEv) : IProp GF
    :=
  i ↪[tn.bt] (b, o)

def TraceSim.bagOf (l : List Etcdraft.Msg) : Etcdraft.Bag :=
  List.foldl Etcdraft.Bag.with [] l

theorem TraceSim.simInv_timeless (C : List w64) (tn : TraceSim.TraceNames) (Fx : Etcdraft.State →
    IProp GF) [hFx : ∀ (σ : Etcdraft.State), Timeless (Fx σ)] : Timeless (TraceSim.simInv C tn Fx)

def TraceSim.SimRun (C : List w64) (L : List TraceEv) (σ : Etcdraft.State) : Prop :=
  L = [] ∧ σ = TraceSim.simInit C ∨
    ∃ lines ts,
      TraceSim.parseLines (List.map TraceSim.evConv L) = Except.ok lines ∧
        (TraceSim.linesTrace C lines).RunRel L.length ts ∧ ts.s = σ ∧ ts.l = L.length + 1

def TraceSim.simNode (tn : TraceSim.TraceNames) (i : w64) (c : TraceSim.ServerC) (P : List
    Etcdraft.Msg) : IProp GF :=
  i ↪[tn.st] (c, P)

def TraceSim.LastOf (L : List TraceEv) (n : GoString) (o : Option TraceEv) : Prop :=
  match o with
  | none => ∀ (x : TraceEv), x ∈ L → x.nid ≠ n
  | some e0 => ∃ L1 L2, L = L1 ++ e0 :: L2 ∧ e0.nid = n ∧ ∀ (x : TraceEv), x ∈ L2 → x.nid ≠ n

def TraceSim.bootFlags (srv : Etcdraft.SetIds) (lines : List Etcdraft.Line) : List Bool :=
  List.map (fun k => (List.map (fun i => (Etcdraft.bootstrapOf lines i).fst) srv).any fun f => f.getD k false)
    (List.range lines.length)

def TraceSim.msg_countable : Pos.Countable Etcdraft.Msg :=
  countableOfLeftInverse
    (fun m =>
      (m.type, m.subtype, m.term, m.lastLogTerm, m.lastLogIndex, m.voteGranted, m.prevLogIndex, m.prevLogTerm, m.entries,
        m.commitIndex, m.success, m.matchIndex, m.source, m.dest))
    (fun p =>
      { type := p.fst, subtype := p.snd.fst, term := p.snd.snd.fst, lastLogTerm := p.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        lastLogIndex := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, voteGranted := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        prevLogIndex := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, prevLogTerm := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        entries := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, commitIndex := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        success := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        matchIndex := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        source := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        dest := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd })
    TraceSim.msg_countable._proof_1

def TraceSim.value_countable : Pos.Countable Etcdraft.Value :=
  countableOfLeftInverse
    (fun v =>
      match v with
      | Etcdraft.Value.val n => Sum.inl n
      | Etcdraft.Value.emptySeq => Sum.inr (Sum.inl ())
      | Etcdraft.Value.conf nc ln => Sum.inr (Sum.inr (nc, ln)))
    (fun x =>
      match x with
      | Sum.inl n => Etcdraft.Value.val n
      | Sum.inr (Sum.inl val) => Etcdraft.Value.emptySeq
      | Sum.inr (Sum.inr p) => Etcdraft.Value.conf p.fst p.snd)
    ⋯

def TraceSim.serverC_countable : Pos.Countable TraceSim.ServerC :=
  countableOfLeftInverse
    (fun v =>
      (v.currentTerm, v.state, v.votedFor, v.lead, v.log, v.commitIndex, v.votesResponded, v.votesGranted, v.matchIndex,
        v.pendingConfChangeIndex, v.config, v.durable))
    (fun p =>
      { currentTerm := p.fst, state := p.snd.fst, votedFor := p.snd.snd.fst, lead := p.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        log := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, commitIndex := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        votesResponded := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, votesGranted := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        matchIndex := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        pendingConfChangeIndex := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        config := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        durable := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd })
    TraceSim.serverC_countable._proof_1

def TraceSim.entryType_countable : Pos.Countable Etcdraft.EntryType :=
  countableOfLeftInverse
    (fun t =>
      match t with
      | Etcdraft.EntryType.value => false
      | Etcdraft.EntryType.config => true)
    (fun b => if b = true then Etcdraft.EntryType.config else Etcdraft.EntryType.value) ⋯

structure TraceSim.TraceNames : Type where
  tr : GName
  st : GName
  bag : GName
  voters : List w64
  bt : GName

def TraceSim.config_countable : Pos.Countable Etcdraft.Config :=
  countableOfLeftInverse (fun c => (c.incoming, c.outgoing, c.learners))
    (fun p => { incoming := p.fst, outgoing := p.snd.fst, learners := p.snd.snd }) TraceSim.config_countable._proof_1

def TraceSim.booted (L : List TraceEv) (i : Etcdraft.ID) : Prop :=
  ∃ x,
    x ∈ L ∧
      ∃ ln,
        Etcdraft.parseLine 0 (TraceSim.evConv x) = Except.ok ln ∧ ln.nid = i ∧ Etcdraft.isBootstrapName ln.ev.name = false

def TraceSim.traceDir (γd : GName) (tn : TraceSim.TraceNames) : IProp GF :=
  dghostVar γd DfracDiscarded tn

def TraceSim.durable_countable : Pos.Countable Etcdraft.Durable :=
  countableOfLeftInverse (fun d => (d.currentTerm, d.votedFor, d.log, d.commitIndex, d.config))
    (fun p =>
      { currentTerm := p.fst, votedFor := p.snd.fst, log := p.snd.snd.fst, commitIndex := p.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        config := p.snd.snd.snd.snd })
    TraceSim.durable_countable._proof_1

def TraceSim.linesTrace (C : List w64) (lines : List Etcdraft.Line) : Etcdraft.Trace :=
  { lines := lines, server := TraceSim.confAbs C, initSrv := TraceSim.confAbs C,
    bootstrap := TraceSim.bootFlags (TraceSim.confAbs C) lines, init := TraceSim.simInit C }

def TraceSim.simInv (C : List w64) (tn : TraceSim.TraceNames) (Fx : Etcdraft.State → IProp GF) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ L σ A B phP phM Bt,
      traceFrag tn.tr L ∗
        ghostMapAuth tn.st 1 A ∗
          ghostMapAuth tn.bag 1 B ∗
            ghostMapAuth tn.bt 1 Bt ∗
              Fx σ ∗
                ⌜TraceSim.SimRun C L σ ∧
                    σ.server = TraceSim.confAbs C ∧
                      (∀ (i : w64), i ∈ C → ∃ P, A !! i = some (TraceSim.toC σ.server (σ.s (TraceSim.idAbs i)), P)) ∧
                        (∀ (i : w64), ¬i ∈ C → A !! i = none) ∧
                          TraceSim.BagRep σ.pendingMessages
                              (List.flatMap (fun i => (Option.map Prod.snd (A !! i)).getD []) C ++ phP) ∧
                            TraceSim.BagRep σ.messages (List.map Prod.snd B.toList ++ phM) ∧
                              σ.preVote = false ∧
                                σ.checkQuorum = false ∧
                                  (∀ (i : w64),
                                      i ∈ C →
                                        ∀ (x : Etcdraft.Msg),
                                          x ∈ (Option.map Prod.snd (A !! i)).getD [] → x.source = TraceSim.idAbs i) ∧
                                    (∀ (i : w64),
                                        i ∈ C →
                                          ∃ b o,
                                            Bt !! i = some (b, o) ∧
                                              (b = true ↔ TraceSim.booted L (TraceSim.idAbs i)) ∧
                                                TraceSim.LastOf L (decStr i) o ∧ (b = true → o.isSome = true)) ∧
                                      TraceSim.SimEvents C.length L⌝)

def TraceSim.msgType_countable : Pos.Countable Etcdraft.MsgType :=
  countableOfLeftInverse
    (fun t =>
      match t with
      | Etcdraft.MsgType.requestVoteRequest => 0
      | Etcdraft.MsgType.requestVoteResponse => 1
      | Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesRequest => 2
      | Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesResponse => 3
      | Etcdraft.MsgType.preVoteRequest => 4
      | Etcdraft.MsgType.preVoteResponse => 5)
    (fun n =>
      match n with
      | 0 => Etcdraft.MsgType.requestVoteRequest
      | 1 => Etcdraft.MsgType.requestVoteResponse
      | 2 => Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesRequest
      | 3 => Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesResponse
      | 4 => Etcdraft.MsgType.preVoteRequest
      | x => Etcdraft.MsgType.preVoteResponse)
    ⋯

def TraceSim.traceNames_countable : Pos.Countable TraceSim.TraceNames :=
  countableOfLeftInverse (fun n => (n.tr, n.st, n.bag, n.voters, n.bt))
    (fun p =>
      { tr := p.fst, st := p.snd.fst, bag := p.snd.snd.fst, voters := p.snd.snd.snd.fst, bt := p.snd.snd.snd.snd })
    TraceSim.traceNames_countable._proof_1

def TraceSim.entry_countable : Pos.Countable Etcdraft.Entry :=
  countableOfLeftInverse (fun e => (e.term, e.type, e.value))
    (fun p => { term := p.fst, type := p.snd.fst, value := p.snd.snd }) TraceSim.entry_countable._proof_1

theorem TraceSim.traceDir_persistent (γd : GName) (tn : TraceSim.TraceNames) : Persistent
    (TraceSim.traceDir γd tn)

theorem TraceSim.newTraceWith_lines (evs : List Etcdraft.Event) (t : Etcdraft.Trace) :
    Etcdraft.newTraceWith evs false false = Except.ok t → TraceSim.parseLines evs = Except.ok
    t.lines ∧ t.bootstrap = TraceSim.bootFlags t.server t.lines

def TraceSim.parseLines (evs : List Etcdraft.Event) : Except Etcdraft.TraceError (List
    Etcdraft.Line) :=
  List.mapM (fun p => Etcdraft.parseLine p.fst p.snd) ((List.range evs.length).zip evs)
